title: Learn the neutral tone in the words you use most
summary: Take the light, unmarked syllables of high-frequency words off the guesswork list.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: The neutral tone has no mark, so nothing in the spelling tells a learner to shorten it. That makes a small list worth memorising early, since these words appear everywhere: 妈妈 māma (mother), 谢谢 xièxie (thanks), 朋友 péngyou (friend), 时候 shíhou (time), 医生 yīshēng (doctor), 什么 shénme (what), and the sentence particles 吧 ba and 呢 ne. Say each one fast and let the second syllable fall off rather than stressing it. If your version of 妈妈 māma sounds like two equal syllables, you are pronouncing a citation form; a light second syllable is what makes it natural.
